recipe.text: Falchion: a single-edged forward-belly cleaver, distinct from prior spear/dagger/scimitar. Blade is a procedural EditableMesh (swept 4-vert profile: straight spine along +Y, edge bulging to a belly ~t=0.72 then converging to a point, thickness tapering), saved durable (asset 99974167012473). Hilt = flat guard + wood grip cylinder Handle + ball pommel. Fast-swing state machine windup 0.10s / active 0.12s / cooldown 0.30s; hitbox 30 dmg over 7 studs with 0.30s server cooldown.
